expressions:
req: workflow.requests[first]
cis_owner_id: find(ci,req.custom_fields.cis).service.service_owner.id
ipar_owner_id: find(ci,req.custom_fields.ipar).service.service_owner.id
global_dict_owner_id: find(ci,req.custom_fields.global_dict).service.service_owner.id
package_ci_owner_id: find(ci,req.custom_fields.package_ci).service.service_owner.id
ci_global_owner_id: find(ci,req.custom_fields.ci_global).service.service_owner.id
cis_manager_id: find(ci,req.custom_fields.cis).service.change_manager.id
ipar_manager_id: find(ci,req.custom_fields.ipar).service.change_manager.id
global_dict_manager_id: find(ci,req.custom_fields.global_dict).service.change_manager.id
package_ci_manager_id: find(ci,req.custom_fields.package_ci).service.change_manager.id
ci_global_manager_id: find(ci,req.custom_fields.ci_global).service.change_manager.id
cis_owner: find_all(person,cis_owner_id)
ipar_owner: find_all(person,ipar_owner_id)
global_dict_owner: find_all(person,global_dict_owner_id)
package_ci_owner: find_all(person,package_ci_owner_id)
ci_global_owner: find_all(person,ci_global_owner_id)
cis_manager: find_all(person,cis_manager_id)
ipar_manager: find_all(person,ipar_manager_id)
global_dict_manager: find_all(person,global_dict_manager_id)
package_ci_manager: find_all(person,package_ci_manager_id)
ci_global_manager: find_all(person,ci_global_manager_id)
all_persons: cis_owner + ipar_owner + global_dict_owner + package_ci_owner + ci_global_owner + cis_manager + ipar_manager + global_dict_manager + package_ci_manager + ci_global_manager
all_persons_no_dis: all_persons.select(disabled = false).select(account = "moscow")
req_by_id: req.requested_by.id
initiator_name: req.requested_by.name
appr_task: successors[first]
no_task: find(task, 0)
req_by_in_massive: all_persons_no_dis.any?(id = req_by_id)
task_to_update: req_by_in_massive ? appr_task : no_task
deployment_team: find(team,req.custom_fields.deployment_team)
team_member: find(person,req.custom_fields.team_member)
wf_task: workflow.tasks[#9766]
cf_start_unavailability: req.custom_fields.planned_release_date_time
cf_duration: req.custom_fields.duration
cf_effort: req.custom_fields.effort
cf_impact: req.custom_fields.impact
notify_client_false: req.custom_fields.notify_client = false
task_notify_1: workflow.tasks[#10862]
task_notify_2: workflow.tasks[#33035]
update_task_notify_1: notify_client_false ? task_notify_1 : no_task
update_task_notify_2: notify_client_false ? task_notify_2 : no_task
name: Отмена задачи план. изменения, если иниц. = влад. услуги/мен. изм.
